This plot is only a small piece near the house, so my family and I can manage it ourselves without hiring anyone. I will apply manure from our cattle because it costs nothing and keeps the soil good, but I will not spend money on chemical fertilizer for such a small plot. We will use our own saved seeds as we always do, and since it is just a small piece, we will pull weeds by hand without buying any sprays. The rains in Mbeya are usually enough, so I will not irrigate.
